_comment: Apps people reach for to get around a block. Blocking these domains stops them being downloaded or updated, and stops most of them working. Add your own in the app.

tools.name: Tor Browser
tools.why: Routes around DNS and hosts blocking entirely. The most common bypass.

tools.name: NordVPN
tools.why: A VPN defeats DNS filtering on every device it runs on.

tools.name: ExpressVPN
tools.why: A VPN defeats DNS filtering on every device it runs on.

tools.name: Proton VPN
tools.why: A VPN defeats DNS filtering on every device it runs on.

tools.name: Psiphon
tools.why: Censorship-circumvention tool. Designed to get around exactly this kind of block.

tools.name: Opera browser
tools.why: Ships with a free built-in VPN, so it needs no separate install.

tools.name: Web proxy sites
tools.why: Load any site through someone else's server, straight past a hosts file.
